objections.claim_attacked: observation: 20k routing congestion DRCs at a GRT failure
objections.objection: The record labels the 20k violations 'routing congestion DRCs' while prior_state says the design failed GRT; it never reconciles whether these are global-route congestion overflows or post-detailed-route DRCs, so the headline count is not tied to a defined measurement point.

objections.claim_attacked: chosen_intervention: the 0.45→0.2 layer adjustment plus 30→35 congestion iterations explain the post_state that GRT completed
objections.objection: Both parameters were changed together and no run isolating either is reported, so the record cannot attribute GRT completion to the layer adjustment, the iteration increase, or both; the separate macro-loop suspicion in #5971 remains an unexcluded confounder.

objections.claim_attacked: hypothesis: adjustment 0.45 is too aggressive and default 30 congestion iterations were insufficient
objections.objection: The record admits the high-vs-low meaning of the layer adjustment is only explained in prose, and it provides no failed-30/run-35 comparison, so the direction and sufficiency of the 0.45→0.2 and 30→35 changes are asserted rather than mechanically demonstrated.

objections.claim_attacked: direct_quote.text supports the full chosen_intervention, including the change to 35 congestion iterations
objections.objection: The direct_quote contains only the sentence about changing routing layer adjustments from 0.45 to 0.2; the second claimed change, iterations to 35, is not in the quoted evidence and therefore lacks the same named/date/locator support.

mechanism_check: HOLDS — given the stated hypothesis that GRT congestion came from an overly aggressive layer adjustment and too few iterations, lowering the adjustment and raising iterations plausibly unblocks GRT, though it does not explain the asserted DRC count.
evidence_check: ASSERT — the post_state is only a reported completion ('could finish GRT', 'complete BoomTile') with no measured post-fix DRC count or runtime.
attribution_check: WEAK — direct_quote names eder-matheus and gives a date and locator, and it supports the 0.45→0.2 change, but it omits the 35-iteration change that chosen_intervention also attributes to the same quote.
missing_from_story: Exact violation category and measurement point for the 20k figure, plus before/after counts for the alleged DRCs or GRT congestion.
A controlled run or ablation showing whether the 0.2 layer adjustment alone, the 35 iterations alone, or both were necessary for GRT completion.
Whether the parameter changes were actually merged, with a PR/commit link, and the final status of the separate macro-loop issue #5971.
The precise semantics and units of set-global-routing-layer-adjustment so the high-vs-low direction can be independently checked.
most_defensible_part: The direct_quote's attribution of the 0.45→0.2 layer-adjustment change to eder-matheus on 2024-11-14 at the issue URL.
